recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片細胞密集、幾乎無脂肪，中央有兩顆偏小的巨核細胞，各只有單一圓形、不分葉的細胞核（monolobated），周圍夾雜許多染色質較開放、核仁可見的未成熟細胞，符合伴隨過多芽細胞的骨髓發育不良（RAEB/MDS-EB）。
features: Hypercellular marrow with sheets of hematopoietic cells and minimal fat
Small megakaryocytes with a single round, non-lobated nucleus (monolobated forms) and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm
Numerous immature-appearing mononuclear cells with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli
Interspersed erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei and scattered eosinophilic granulocytes
No fibrosis or lymphoid aggregates evident in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section shows a hypercellular marrow with little residual fat. Megakaryocytes are dysplastic, including small forms with single round, non-lobated nuclei. The background contains a mixed population of maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors with numerous immature mononuclear cells showing open chromatin and small nucleoli, raising concern for an increase in blasts. CD34 immunohistochemistry and an aspirate differential are needed to quantify blasts. Findings are suggestive of a myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: CMML shares dysplastic megakaryocytes but requires persistent peripheral monocytosis, with CD14/CD163-positive monocytes increased in the marrow.
CML has small hypolobated megakaryocytes too, but with a packed granulocytic marrow, basophilia, and BCR::ABL1 fusion.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes
ddx.vs: AML requires ≥20% blasts, typically forming sheets of CD34-positive cells, whereas MDS-EB has 5–19% marrow blasts.

ddx.dx: Reactive marrow after G-CSF or regeneration
ddx.vs: Regenerating marrow shows a left shift with synchronous maturation and normally lobated megakaryocytes, without monolobated forms or clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.
